interactives.label: Garden well
interactives.text: Cold water from the garden well.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: The lineage
interactives.text: The archive holds the lineage; the stelae hold the order. What is made under the sun vault is copied into both and counts double.

interactives.label: Training post
interactives.text: The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Reading
interactives.text: The plaza's under-room. Books read three times as fast in the jade quiet.

interactives.label: The archive
interactives.text: The royal archive is the room behind the sun vault. It was entered from the steppe once, by mistake, on paper.

interactives.label: The falls
interactives.text: North falls and east falls drain the same cistern. The cistern shaft is the honest way down.

interactives.label: Warm spring
interactives.text: The spring is warm and mineral; it restores you.

interactives.label: Butts
interactives.text: The butts list your recent combat results.

interactives.label: The rebuke
interactives.text: The ruling under rebuke was written in the archive and read at the stelae. The two copies differ by one name.

interactives.label: The verification
interactives.text: Verification lapsed when the copyist who kept it drowned in the cistern, or left.

interactives.label: The tenth
interactives.text: The tenth mouth of the delta was claimed by the ruins and the claim was never carried down.

interactives.label: The Sun Stela Reliquary
interactives.text: Opened with sunstone flint, the stela's own fire.

interactives.label: Ward post
interactives.text: Nothing casts within these stones. The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Cistern
interactives.text: Rainwater from the cistern.

interactives.label: Breath
interactives.text: Rest here and the breath comes back twice as fast.

interactives.label: Keys
interactives.text: A secret that asks for an item asks for it in your pack, not in your hand. It is not used up.

sections.name: The Scale-Moss Hollow
sections.label: A knot of roots grown over a door frame.
sections.note: A hollow under the root arch where the scale moss grows thick and undisturbed.

sections.name: The Lily Court Garden
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: The court's sunken garden, kept by the archive's copyists.

sections.name: The Serpent Gate Cache
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: The gate-keepers' cellar: chest, bench and flint enough for a siege.

sections.name: The Sun Vault Undercroft
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: The strongroom under the sun vault.

sections.name: The Hatchery Pit
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: A brood cell the wardens stock for the young to learn on.

sections.name: The Ritual Plaza School
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Where the copyists learn the lineage.

sections.name: The East Falls Spring
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: Behind the east falls a warm chamber the temple never recorded.

sections.name: The West Shrine Butts
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: A gallery under the west shrine with herons at the far end.

sections.name: The Sun Stela Reliquary
sections.label: A shrine slab with fresh scratches where it has been slid aside.
sections.note: Opened with sunstone flint, the stela's own fire.

sections.name: The Cistern Well
sections.label: An iron drain grate, its bolts drawn.
sections.note: The cistern's jade drinks every spell; the crocodile penned there does not care.

sections.name: The Great Temple Focus
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Under the great temple the ether pools; spells cost half.

sections.name: The Root-Run
sections.label: A knot of roots grown over a door frame.
sections.note: A root-run under the border, out by the delta's great banyan.

sections.name: The Ruins Waystone
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Four stones under the channel bridge. An iron rune wakes them.

sections.name: The East Shrine Eyrie
sections.label: An arch so grown with vine it reads as hedge.
sections.note: A pocket over the east shrine.

secrets.note: Each section is one secret. The client shows a player only the section they stand in; the server places the arrival, the areas, the spawns and the harvest nodes from this block.

provenance.geometry: authored with the secret rooms kit over the shared toolkit

notes: 14 secrets of Ssarathi Ruins Secrets on one map with void between them; which one a player gets is which feature of the ground above they used.
